svg.title: Sharing a port
svg.desc: A tls-server listener peeks at the first three bytes of each connection. A TLS handshake (16 03 00 to 04) gets the outer TLS; after it, an HTTP request becomes a WebSocket when tls-transport-ws is set and the path matches, else it gets an HTTP error. Other bytes are served as OpenVPN TCP when tls-transport-accept-tcp is set, else the connection is closed.
